audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-019: Is EIP-7702 Authorization validation complete?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: SetCodeAuthorization struct with fields ChainID, Address, Nonce, V, R, S. Authority() validates ECDSA signature using crypto.ValidateSignatureValues(). SigHash() computes hash with 0x05 prefix.
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Direct implementation of EIP-7702 authorization validation
initial_concerns: V value validated as 0/1 in crypto.ValidateSignatureValues

validation_paths_checked: Authority() -> crypto.ValidateSignatureValues() -> validates r,s range and v parity
validateAuthorization() in state_transition.go checks ChainID and nonce
edge_cases_identified: Zero ChainID is explicitly allowed (wildcard)
Nonce overflow checked with auth.Nonce+1 < auth.Nonce
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Authorization comes from external transaction input, parsed via RLP decoding. Validation occurs before application.

phase3_findings.evidence: crypto.ValidateSignatureValues() at tx_setcode.go:111 validates r,s in [1, secp256k1n-1] and v in {0,1}. validateAuthorization() at state_transition.go:573-600 validates ChainID and nonce. Authority() recovers signer from validated signature.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Invalid signature values rejected by ValidateSignatureValues
Wrong chain ID rejected with ErrAuthorizationWrongChainID

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-020: Does encode_account produce deterministic canonical RLP?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: StateAccount struct with Nonce, Balance, Root, CodeHash fields. rlp.EncodeToBytes() used for serialization. SlimAccountRLP provides optimized format.
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - RLP encoding determinism critical for consensus
initial_concerns: Struct field order defines RLP encoding order

validation_paths_checked: rlp.EncodeToBytes() follows strict struct field order
StateAccount fields in order: Nonce, Balance, Root, CodeHash
edge_cases_identified: EmptyRootHash and EmptyCodeHash handled specially in SlimAccountRLP
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Account encoding used internally for state trie updates, determinism essential for consensus

phase3_findings.evidence: Go RLP library encodes structs deterministically by field order. StateAccount at state_account.go:29-34 defines canonical order. No optional fields or maps that could cause non-determinism.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Field reordering impossible due to Go struct definition
Balance uses uint256.Int which serializes deterministically

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the GAS_CAP constant validated as exactly 16777216 (2^24)?

edge_cases_identified: None - compile-time constant
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Constant value is immutable after compilation

phase3_findings.evidence: params/protocol_params.go:31 defines MaxTxGas = 1 << 24 which equals 16777216 (2^24). This is a compile-time constant.
attack_vectors_analyzed: All usages reference the same constant

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-001: Does the txpool reject transactions with gasLimit > 16777216?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: if rules.IsOsaka && tx.Gas() > params.MaxTxGas { return fmt.Errorf("%w (cap: %d, tx: %d)", core.ErrGasLimitTooHigh, params.MaxTxGas, tx.Gas()) }
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Direct txpool gas limit validation
initial_concerns: Check is conditional on IsOsaka fork activation

validation_paths_checked: ValidateTransaction called for all txpool submissions
Gas check occurs after fork-based tx type checks
edge_cases_identified: Pre-Osaka transactions not subject to this limit
Limit applies to Osaka fork onwards
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Validation at txpool entry point - external transactions validated before acceptance

phase3_findings.evidence: core/txpool/validation.go:92-94 explicitly checks tx.Gas() > params.MaxTxGas and returns ErrGasLimitTooHigh when violated. This runs for every transaction entering the pool after Osaka fork.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Oversized gas transactions rejected with clear error
Check cannot be bypassed for pool submissions

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-002: Does P2P-relayed transaction gasLimit validation match local submission validation?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: ValidateTransaction is used for both local and P2P transactions via same codepath
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Consistency between local and P2P validation
initial_concerns: Need to verify same validation function used for both paths

validation_paths_checked: txpool.Add() uses ValidateTransaction for local txs
P2P handler uses same ValidateTransaction function
edge_cases_identified: ValidationOptions may differ but gas check is unconditional
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Both local RPC and P2P paths converge on ValidateTransaction

phase3_findings.evidence: ValidateTransaction at validation.go:56 is the single validation entry point used by both local submission and P2P relay paths. The MaxTxGas check at line 92-94 applies uniformly.
attack_vectors_analyzed: No separate validation path for P2P that could bypass gas check

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Is the transaction gasLimit cap (16777216) enforced at block validation?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: if isOsaka && msg.GasLimit > params.MaxTxGas { return fmt.Errorf("%w (cap: %d, tx: %d)", ErrGasLimitTooHigh, params.MaxTxGas, msg.GasLimit) }
initial_concerns: Validation in preCheck() which runs during block execution

validation_paths_checked: execute() called for every transaction in block processing
edge_cases_identified: Check conditional on Osaka fork
Runs after nonce and balance checks
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Defense-in-depth: block validation checks same limit as txpool

phase3_findings.evidence: state_transition.go:401-404 validates msg.GasLimit against params.MaxTxGas during block execution. This runs for every transaction regardless of origin.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Malicious blocks with oversized-gas txs rejected
Cannot bypass via direct block import

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003/tb-005: Does block validation iterate over ALL transactions for gas cap check?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Block processor iterates all transactions calling ApplyTransaction which calls stateTransition.execute()

validation_paths_checked: Each tx goes through ApplyMessage -> execute() -> preCheck()
edge_cases_identified: Early exit on first invalid tx (by design)
All txs up to invalid one are validated
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Sequential processing ensures no transaction skipped

phase3_findings.evidence: Standard Go for-range loop over block transactions ensures every transaction is processed. preCheck() runs for each, validating gas limit individually.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Cannot skip transactions in middle of block

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Does block validation atomically reject blocks with any over-cap transaction?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: preCheck returns error which propagates up, causing block rejection
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Atomic block rejection on invalid tx
initial_concerns: Error propagation must prevent partial block acceptance

validation_paths_checked: Block processor aborts on any ApplyMessage error
edge_cases_identified: State is rolled back on block rejection via snapshot mechanism
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Go error propagation ensures atomic failure

phase3_findings.evidence: Error from preCheck() at state_transition.go:403 propagates through execute() returning (nil, error), causing ApplyMessage to return error, which causes block processor to reject entire block.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is per-transaction gas cap independent of block gas limit?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Gas cap check uses params.MaxTxGas constant, not header.GasLimit
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Independence of tx gas cap from block gas limit
initial_concerns: Check uses hardcoded constant, not dynamic value

validation_paths_checked: Block gas limit is header.GasLimit, separate variable
edge_cases_identified: Block gas limit can exceed MaxTxGas
Individual tx still capped at MaxTxGas
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Two independent limits serve different purposes

phase3_findings.evidence: state_transition.go:402 compares msg.GasLimit to params.MaxTxGas (constant 16777216), not to any block-related value. Block gas limit is checked separately.
attack_vectors_analyzed: High block gas limit cannot enable oversized tx gas

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the gas cap (16777216) independently enforced at BOTH txpool AND block validation?

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Two independent checks: txpool/validation.go:92-94 and state_transition.go:401-404
initial_concerns: Both checks use same constant and condition

validation_paths_checked: txpool: ValidateTransaction checks before pool acceptance
edge_cases_identified: Both checks conditional on Osaka fork
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Defense in depth: txpool prevents spam, block validation ensures consensus

phase3_findings.evidence: txpool/validation.go:92-94 and state_transition.go:401-404 both independently check tx.Gas()/msg.GasLimit > params.MaxTxGas. Neither relies on the other.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Txpool bypass (direct block) caught by state_transition
State_transition bypass impossible for valid blocks

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The RLP encoding of an Account MUST produce a tuple in the strict order (nonce, ...)

No runtime field order modification possible

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The input to encode_account MUST be a valid Account instance

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The storage_root parameter passed to encode_account MUST be exactly 32 bytes

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The keccak256 hash of the account code MUST be computed over the raw code bytes

edge_cases_identified: Empty code hashes to EmptyCodeHash constant
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Hash computed at code storage time

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: EMPTY_ACCOUNT MUST be a module-level constant that is frozen and immutable

edge_cases_identified: No singleton pattern - each call creates new object
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Implementation uses factory pattern rather than constant

attack_vectors_analyzed: Factory pattern prevents mutation of shared state
remaining_risks: Design differs from specification (factory vs constant) but achieves same safety goal

recommendations: Note: Geth uses factory pattern rather than constant, achieving equivalent safety

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: EMPTY_ACCOUNT MUST have nonce == Uint(0), balance == U256(0), and code == b''

edge_cases_identified: Go zero values used implicitly for Nonce
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Factory ensures consistent empty account values

phase3_findings.evidence: NewEmptyStateAccount at state_account.go:37-43 sets Nonce=0 (Go zero value), Balance=new(uint256.Int) which is 0, and CodeHash=EmptyCodeHash.Bytes(). Code is implicitly empty (nil).
attack_vectors_analyzed: No way to construct different 'empty' account

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-014): The type alias Address MUST be exactly Bytes20 (20 bytes)

edge_cases_identified: BytesToAddress truncates/pads to 20 bytes

phase3_findings.evidence: common/types.go:39 defines AddressLength=20. Address type is [AddressLength]byte = [20]byte. Go array types have fixed, compile-time size.

audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: The type alias Bloom MUST be exactly Bytes256 (256 bytes)

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-018): The Authorization dataclass for EIP-7702 MUST include chain_id for replay protection

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: SetCodeAuthorization struct has ChainID uint256.Int field, included in SigHash()
phase1_summary.property_relevance: HIGH - Replay protection via chain ID
initial_concerns: ChainID is first field, included in signature hash

validation_paths_checked: SigHash() includes ChainID in hash preimage
edge_cases_identified: Zero ChainID is wildcard (valid on any chain)
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: ChainID binding in signature prevents cross-chain replay

phase3_findings.evidence: SetCodeAuthorization at tx_setcode.go:70-76 includes ChainID field. SigHash() at lines 104-108 includes a.ChainID in the hash preimage: prefixedRlpHash(0x05, []any{a.ChainID, a.Address, a.Nonce}).

Zero ChainID is intentional wildcard per EIP-7702

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-018): The (y_parity, r, s) fields of an Authorization MUST form a valid ECDSA signature

initial_concerns: ValidateSignatureValues checks r,s range and v parity

validation_paths_checked: ValidateSignatureValues validates: v in {0,1}, r,s in [1, secp256k1n-1]
edge_cases_identified: Malleable signatures rejected (homestead=true)
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Full ECDSA validation before address recovery

phase3_findings.evidence: Authority() at tx_setcode.go:111-131 validates via crypto.ValidateSignatureValues() which checks v∈{0,1}, 1≤r<n, 1≤s<n/2 (homestead). Ecrecover returns error on invalid signature.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-018): The nonce field in an Authorization MUST match the current nonce of the authorizing account

edge_cases_identified: First authorization for account uses nonce 0
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Nonce check prevents replay of old authorizations

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): The extract_deposit_data function MUST reject any input data whose length does not equal DEPOSIT_EVENT_DATA_LENGTH

edge_cases_identified: 576 bytes is ABI-encoded deposit event data length

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): All five offsets in extract_deposit_data MUST match their expected constant values

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Offsets computed from constants, data extracted at fixed positions
initial_concerns: Hardcoded offsets based on ABI encoding spec

edge_cases_identified: ABI encoding pads to 32-byte boundaries
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Fixed offsets based on known ABI structure

phase3_findings.evidence: deposit.go:34-40 defines output offsets as constants. Data extraction at lines 44-61 uses calculated input positions (32*5+32=192 start, then fixed increments). These match ABI encoding of 5 dynamic elements.

remaining_risks: No validation of ABI offset fields in input - assumes valid ABI encoding if length matches

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): All five sizes in extract_deposit_data MUST match their expected constant values

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-016): The output of extract_deposit_data MUST be exactly 192 bytes

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): Every validation failure path in extract_deposit_data MUST terminate with an error

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): parse_deposit_requests MUST only process logs emitted by DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-016): parse_deposit_requests MUST accumulate deposit data without gaps

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-018): The r and s values of an Authorization MUST be in the range [1, SECP256K1_ORDER - 1]

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: crypto.ValidateSignatureValues checks r,s range

edge_cases_identified: Zero r or s rejected
s > secp256k1n/2 rejected (malleable)

phase3_findings.evidence: crypto.ValidateSignatureValues at tx_setcode.go:111 with homestead=true validates 1≤r<n and 1≤s<n/2 where n is secp256k1 order. Zero values and out-of-range values rejected.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The receipts trie MUST be complete

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Block validation computes and verifies receipt root

validation_paths_checked: Receipt trie computed from all tx receipts
edge_cases_identified: Missing receipt causes root mismatch

phase3_findings.evidence: Block validation computes receipt trie from all transaction executions. ReceiptHash in header must match computed trie root. Missing/extra receipts cause mismatch and block rejection.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Cannot omit receipts without changing root

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: The decode_receipt function MUST correctly decode the receipt

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Receipt.DecodeRLP implements standard RLP decoding

edge_cases_identified: Type prefix for post-EIP-2718 receipts

phase3_findings.evidence: Receipt encoding/decoding in receipt.go follows RLP specification. DecodeRLP correctly parses status, cumulative gas, bloom, and logs fields. Type-prefixed receipts handled correctly.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-020): The offset validation in extract_deposit_data MUST read offsets as big-endian unsigned integers

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Geth's implementation uses fixed offsets, not reading from data
initial_concerns: Implementation uses compile-time offsets, not runtime parsing

validation_paths_checked: Offsets are constants, not read from input
ABI structure assumed valid if length=576
edge_cases_identified: No offset validation, relies on length check

phase3_findings.evidence: Geth's DepositLogToRequest uses hardcoded offsets rather than reading ABI offset fields. The 576-byte length check ensures enough data exists, but offset values in input are not validated.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Malformed ABI with wrong offsets would extract wrong data
Length check prevents buffer overrun but not semantic errors
remaining_risks: ABI offset fields not validated - relies on CL to provide valid ABI data

recommendations: Consider validating ABI offset fields match expected values

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-016): The concatenation order in extract_deposit_data MUST be exactly pubkey + withdrawal_credentials + amount + signature + index

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Output offsets define: pubkey(0), withdrawal_cred(48), amount(80), signature(88), index(184)
initial_concerns: Copy operations place fields in correct positions

edge_cases_identified: None

phase3_findings.evidence: deposit.go:34-40 defines output offsets ensuring order: pubkey(0:48), withdrawal_credentials(48:80), amount(80:88), signature(88:184), index(184:192). Copy operations at lines 46-61 place data at these positions.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: The SHA-256 implementation used in compute_requests_hash MUST conform to FIPS 180-4

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Uses Go standard library crypto/sha256 which is FIPS compliant

edge_cases_identified: None

phase3_findings.evidence: Geth uses Go standard library crypto/sha256 which implements FIPS 180-4 compliant SHA-256. This is the authoritative Go implementation.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-019): The storage_root parameter in encode_account MUST be validated against the storage trie Merkle root

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Storage root computed from actual storage trie during state commit
initial_concerns: Root computed, not passed as parameter

validation_paths_checked: Storage trie root computed during commit
edge_cases_identified: Empty storage uses EmptyRootHash
phase2_summary.trust_boundary_analysis: Root is computed, not externally supplied

phase3_findings.evidence: StateDB computes storage root from storage trie during commit. Account.Root is set to computed root, not from external input. No parameter validation needed as root is derived.

audit_items.title: Verify Pre-Condition: In parse_deposit_requests, the log.topics array MUST be checked for non-empty length

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Topic validation occurs in consensus layer

validation_paths_checked: CL checks log has topics before accessing
edge_cases_identified: Empty topics would not match deposit signature

phase3_findings.evidence: Log topic validation is a consensus layer responsibility. Geth's DepositLogToRequest receives log data after CL has validated structure.
attack_vectors_analyzed: Empty topics wouldn't match event signature

recommendations: This check applies to consensus layer client

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity (tb-018): The authorization address field MUST be a valid 20-byte Ethereum address

phase1_summary.code_analyzed: Address common.Address - 20-byte array type

edge_cases_identified: Zero address (0x00..00) is valid but may be special-cased

phase3_findings.evidence: SetCodeAuthorization.Address at tx_setcode.go:71 is common.Address type which is [20]byte. Go array types have fixed size enforced at compile time. RLP decoding validates correct size.
